decisions.reason: The black-finish range builds directly on the firm's core drainage know-how and its own manufacturing, and its visibility on the website has grown from a mention to a dedicated page, so management can read its results well and sees no reason to drop it.

The shower channel for seamless coverings sits close to the established offer and fits the trend toward modern, barrier-free bathrooms, and it has kept a dedicated page in both years, which points to stable support from the firm's in-house development.

The pump-drain shower channel only builds on the core offer and follows the withdrawn pump solution C, so it carries more risk, but the firm's own research and development lets it learn from C's experience, so it is kept after just one year on the market.
